name: # Truth table for StatusEngine. PLAN.md section 9. One row per case; every row of the
# evaluation table appears at least once
asOf: then the precedence and threshold cases.

name: # treatments  ";"-separated. Each item: LABEL confidence citingDate citingMayDepart citingEcli
#             citingCourt is NSS and citingPanel is derived from citingMayDepart by the test.
# provisions  ";"-separated. Each item: provisionId changedOn reworded material derogatedBy
# "-" in any of those three columns means an empty list; "-" in a field means null.
# expectedReasons  ";"-separated Reason variant names in the exact order the engine must
#                  return them. "-" means the list must be empty.
# All ECLIs are TEST- prefixed so that they cannot resolve against real crawled data.
# --- one row per line of the evaluation table -----------------------------------------
quashed
comment: table row 1: formally annulled

name: departed_with_authority
comment: table row 2: extended panel may depart so this is a supersession

name: provision_derogated
comment: table row 3: derogation with no treatments at all still goes red

name: departed_without_authority
comment: table row 4: ordinary panel cannot bind so it is a conflict not a supersession

name: narrowed
comment: table row 5: scope limited

name: provision_reworded_material
comment: table row 6: reworded after the decision and judged material

name: unclassified
comment: table row 7: validation failed twice so the user is told to look

name: inherited_red
comment: table row 8: one hop from a red source

name: no_adverse_treatment
comment: table row 9: green with an empty reason list

name: mentioned_is_green
comment: a party citing a case is not the court relying on it

name: distinguished_is_green
comment: accepting the rule on different facts leaves the rule intact

name: criticized_is_green
comment: disagreement without authority changes nothing

name: followed_is_green
comment: agreement is not adverse treatment

name: quashed_beats_narrowed
comment: red wins the light but the amber fact is still listed after it

name: red_beats_inherited_amber
comment: inherited weakness never downgrades an established red

name: departed_with_beats_departed_without
comment: authority decides which of two departures sets the light

name: derogation_beats_narrowing
comment: provision row and treatment row both cited

name: quashed_at_red_threshold

name: conflict_below_amber_threshold
comment: below the amber bar

name: unclassified_exempt_from_threshold

name: mixed_thresholds

name: citation_after_asof_ignored

name: citation_on_asof_counts

name: rewording_after_asof_ignored
